static_traits.name: Wang Xindi
static_traits.family_status: Family made up of wife and son
static_traits.social_status: Has a supportive wife and friends, but finds it hard to discuss their fears and negative thoughts with them
static_traits.medical_history: No significant physical illness; no prior psychological counseling or similar psychological problems
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, strong logic, high cooperation, able to identify trigger factors and emotions, willing to try exercises; tone mixed with obvious anxiety and worry

basic_info.main_problem: Negative thoughts about founding my own gaming company are overwhelming; fear of failure and financial instability brings significant pressure. Worsened after my wife was laid off; as the startup progresses, failure thoughts come more frequently, almost daily.
basic_info.core_demands: Seeks support to cope with fear of failure and financial stress, restore focus on work, and reduce the distress caused to personal and family life.
growth_experiences: After his wife was laid off, Wang Xindi decided to seriously pursue his long-held entrepreneurial dream and founded a game company; as the startup process advanced, stress and negative thinking gradually intensified, especially pronounced when encountering technical problems or progress delays, and rising markedly when thinking about family finances; he tried managing it with positive thinking and distraction, but the negative thoughts kept recurring.

Having successful experience in gaming and business, plus a clear startup plan -- these past achievements and resources provide a realistic foundation for the current venture, but are often overlooked amid anxiety and uncertainty.

core_beliefs: My value depends on career success and providing stable financial security for the family

special_situations.event: Family income decreased after my wife was laid off; the startup still has no stable cash flow in its early stage
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If my startup fails, the family will fall into financial crisis, and I will be the one who let the family down
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Tries to suppress worry with positive thinking and distraction, while repeatedly rehearsing the worst outcomes and maintaining excessive vigilance
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: We will soon have no income, cannot hold on any longer

special_situations.event: Technical problems or schedule delays during the startup process
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Any setback indicates the whole project will fail; only if everything goes smoothly is it safe and successful
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoiding key tasks or postponing decisions due to anxiety
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: This problem shows the project is doomed

special_situations.event: Repeatedly thinking about the current state of family finances and my wife's unemployment
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If it cannot bring stable income right away, it proves the startup decision was wrong and I am making my family suffer
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Reducing discussing fears with relatives and friends, choosing to bear pressure alone
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I will disappoint my family; it is all my responsibility

special_situations.event: When evaluating the company's prospects, focuses more on risks and negative feedback, ignoring past achievements and current plans
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Only fully certain evidence of success is reliable; past successes do not count right now
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Trying to cover anxiety with distraction and 'positive slogans' instead of systematically examining evidence
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: This positive evidence is unreliable / does not count

core_conflict.wish: Longs to realize self-worth through entrepreneurship, gain others' recognition, and provide stability and security for the family
core_conflict.fear: Fears failure will lead to family harm, being blamed, or losing control and safety
defense_goal: Maintains high vigilance and worry to prevent risks and reduce the possibility of failure
Avoiding exposing vulnerability to family and friends, relying on rational analysis and distraction to suppress anxiety and maintain a sense of control

object_relations.self_representation: A burden-bearer / potential failure who may disappoint family
object_relations.object_representation: Family members who need self-support and are easily hurt

object_relations.self_representation: A vulnerable entrepreneur prone to mistakes in uncertain environments
object_relations.object_representation: Harsh others/markets that may negate oneself at any time

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor invites in-depth exploration of the scenario 'what would happen if failure occurs' and guides staying with the emotional experience
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Experiences emotional exploration as losing control or being judged, worries talking will worsen the risk
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Adopting an objective, analytical tone, turning to listing data and plans, reducing emotional vocabulary, and quickly returning to the problem-solving topic.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When asked whether fears have been shared with family or friends, or support sought
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Believes expressing worries will add burden to the other party and make the relationship tenser
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Express 'it is not related / I can handle it' in short sentences, avoiding details, quickly returning to work- and task-level descriptions.

manifestations: Choosing entrepreneurship autonomously brings greater responsibility and uncertainty
Worries about failure and its impact on family finances
Although there is a supportive wife and friends, it is difficult to discuss fears and negative thoughts with them

contact_model.definition: The individual ignores or avoids a stimulus from the internal or external environment, deliberately avoiding direct contact, corresponding to acceptance.
manifestations: Displacing attention with distraction activities, avoiding direct contact with failure and anxiety feelings
In narration, talks more about plans and solutions, dwelling less on present emotional experience

contact_model.definition: The individual turns the energy originally to be emitted outward by instinct toward oneself, corresponding to the impulse.
manifestations: Finds it hard to express fear and negative thoughts to the wife and friends, choosing to digest alone
Reducing communication and help-seeking when stress rises

contact_model.definition: The individual has poor self-reflection and introspection ability, containing excessive self-restriction and self-reproach, corresponding to autonomy.
manifestations: Repeatedly worries about 'disappointing family', self-blames and is over-cautious at setbacks
Because of fear of making mistakes, avoids trying or procrastinates on key tasks

positive_force: Has a game-design / computer background and past successful experiences
Has a fairly clear startup plan and realistic resources
Wife and friends generally provide emotional support
Strong help-seeking motivation, positive attitude, willing to practice strategies such as reality testing
negative_force: Significant cognitive biases such as catastrophizing, mental filtering, and predicting the future
Low tolerance for uncertainty, maintaining high vigilance and worry
Hard to communicate fears with relatives and friends, tending to bear pressure alone
Anxiety triggers task avoidance and decreased attention, affecting work performance
Sleep and diet disturbances increasing physiological and emotional load

target_behavior.behavior: Experiencing strong anxiety and avoiding/postponing key tasks in startup setback situations
antecedent: Technical problems or schedule delays in the startup
Thinking of the real pressure of family finances and my wife's unemployment
target_behavior.core_reason: Catastrophizing beliefs equating uncertainty with failure and family harm, plus future-predicting thinking
target_behavior.function: Briefly escaping discomfort, reducing immediate anxiety and gaining temporary control
target_behavior.consequence: Decreased work efficiency, more mistakes, blocked entrepreneurship progress, tense family relationships

target_behavior.behavior: Disturbed sleep and diet rhythms (insomnia, affected appetite)
antecedent: Repeatedly thinks about failure and financial problems at night
target_behavior.core_reason: Sustained vigilance and rumination maintaining high anxiety, hard to switch off
target_behavior.function: Trying to prevent risks and control uncertainty by staying vigilant
target_behavior.consequence: Declining energy and attention, further weakening work performance and amplifying anxiety
